topic: Visualizing Complex Equations: Winding Numbers and Domain Coloring

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Geometry of Complex Numbers
lecture_lines: Complex numbers form a flexible 2D plane.
Functions transform this plane like rubber sheets.
Squaring inputs creates a swirling vortex.
animations: Display complex plane (x, y) with color #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sheet.svg].
Plot point z at (2, 1) and label as 'z' in #FFFF00.
Draw vector from (0, 0) to point z in #FF00FF.

sections.title: Numerical Root Finding in 2D
lecture_lines: Numerical root finding extends to complex spaces.
We search for points where magnitude vanishes.
Basins of attraction reveal root locations.
animations: Show equation f(z) = 0 and mark root with 'X' in #FF0000 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/target.svg].
Draw circular path around the root in #00FFFF.
Highlight root location with flashing circle in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lens.svg].

sections.title: Decoding the Winding Number
lecture_lines: Winding numbers count wraps around the origin.
They act as topological root fingerprints.
This connects geometry to the Argument Principle.
animations: Draw closed loop curve around the root in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fingerprint.svg] as a path reference.
Animate function f(z) mapping curve in #FFFF00.

sections.title: Domain Coloring: The Visual Language of Functions
lecture_lines: Color maps phase and magnitude of functions.
Complex outputs turn into navigable terrains.
Zeros appear as black holes in color.
animations: Map grid phase to color spectrum in #00FFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg].
Scale color saturation by magnitude in #FFFFFF.
Render zeros as stationary black dots in #000000 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].

sections.title: Synthesis: Solving Equations Visually
lecture_lines: Verify root counts via winding numbers.
animations: Overlay color field with winding path in #FF00FF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Animate mapping pushing root towards zero in #FFFF00.
Pulse solution point with white ring in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/stylus.svg].
